---
title: "Duckdb vs Dataframe"
---

## Load required libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(DBI)
library(microbenchmark)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Generate random dataset
```{r}
set.seed(42)
n_rows <- 1e7

df_base <- data.frame(
  id = sample(1:1000, n_rows, replace = TRUE),
  category = sample(letters[1:10], n_rows, replace = TRUE),
  value = rnorm(n_rows, mean = 100, sd = 15)
)
df_base |> head()
```

## Create DB
```{r}
con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())

base_table_name <- "base_table"
dbWriteTable(con, base_table_name, df_base)
```


## Task: Group by category and calculate mean/max
```{r}
# Native R
run_native_r <- function() {
  df_base |>
    group_by(category) |>
    summarise(
      avg_val = mean(value),
      max_val = max(value),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# DuckDB
run_duckdb <- function() {
  tbl(con, base_table_name) |> 
    group_by(category) |>
    summarise(
      avg_val = mean(value),
      max_val = max(value),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    as_tibble()      # Bring result back to R memory
}

print("Starting benchmark (this may take a few seconds)...")
results <- microbenchmark(
  Native_R = run_native_r(),
  DuckDB   = run_duckdb(),
  times = 5
)
results
```



## Task: Filter
```{r}
# Native R
run_native_r <- function() {
  df_base |>
    filter(value > 50)
}

# DuckDB
run_duckdb <- function() {
  tbl(con, base_table_name) |> 
    filter(value > 50)
}

print("Starting benchmark (this may take a few seconds)...")
results <- microbenchmark(
  Native_R = run_native_r(),
  DuckDB   = run_duckdb(),
  times = 5
)
results
```
